about: Todole app screenshots (iPhone, 1179x2406, status bar removed; a private folder/task name was replaced with 'Client work'/'Client call' and the typo 'Emplyoee' fixed at the owner's request). Describe only what is visible here. 'hold': true = do not use until the owner confirms.

screenshots.shows: A task opened from the Inbox ('Check list') with its date and time range (Sun, 1 Nov, 13:00-23:05) in red, notes with start and end time, a priority flag button, and buttons for labels, a checklist and attachments. In the background list: a task 'Client call'.

The add sheet with a Task/Project switch, a new task 'Appointment', an 'Add notes...' field, the hint 'Try "tomorrow 5pm p1 #project @label"', and chips for Inbox, Today, Reminders and Priority. Keyboard open.
features: natural language dates and tags (per the hint)

screenshots.shows: A Templates page with search and categories Featured, Work, Personal, Education. Work: 'Client management' (board, 'Organize your work with clients from first call to...') and 'Meeting agenda' (list, 'Run a focused meeting and capture the follow-...'). Personal: 'Fitness plan' and 'Grocery list'.
The Dashboard with an options menu open: Search, Select projects, New folder, List view, Sort, Completed projects, Archived projects, Manage folders, Templates, Open menu.

Smart lists (Search, Inbox 19, Today 21, Upcoming, Filters & Labels), folders 'Todole' and 'Client work', and projects 4/5: Client management (starred, 15), Project kickoff (6), Research project (12).
Notifications: 'Todole shared a task with you' (voice note, 16 Nov) and 'Todole shared a project with you' (Employee Management, 16 Nov).

Productivity page: 21 completed tasks, Daily / Weekly / Karma tabs, daily goal 0/5 tasks ('What's first on your list?', Edit goals), daily streak 0 days (longest 1 day), completed in the last 7 days chart.

Settings: Upgrade to Pro banner, Productivity 0/5 today, Appearance, Language (English), Notifications, Integrations, App lock ('Require Face ID / fingerprint to open Todole', on), Export my data (CSV, JSON).
features: app lock with Face ID or fingerprint
export data as CSV or JSON
